question: What are the eligibility criteria for the AICTE Tuition Fee Waiver Scheme (TFW)?
answer:
The eligibility criteria for the AICTE Tuition Fee Waiver Scheme (TFW) are:
(a) Admission to supernumerary seats [Scholarship_AY_2026_27_website_Apr_1_6c85696a82.pdf, p. 2-3].
(b) Awarded to 2% of approved seats of the program, as per merit [Scholarship_AY_2026_27_website_Apr_1_6c85696a82.pdf, p. 2-3].
(c) Students whose parents' annual income from all sources does not exceed Rs. 8.00 lakhs per annum are eligible [Scholarship_AY_2026_27_website_Apr_1_6c85696a82.pdf, p. 2-3].
(d) Valid Income Certificate issued by the State Authorities only will be accepted [Scholarship_AY_2026_27_website_Apr_1_6c85696a82.pdf, p. 2-3].

Based on the provided documents, the AICTE Tuition Fee Waiver (TFW) Scheme and the William Webster Merit-cum-Means Scholarship have the following financial and award conditions:

**AICTE Tuition Fee Waiver (TFW) Scheme:**
- **Award Conditions:** Offered as supernumerary seats to 2% of approved seats of a program based on merit [Scholarship_AY_2026_27_website_Apr_1_6c85696a82.pdf, p. 2-3]. Eligible students' parents' annual income from all sources must not exceed Rs. 8.00 lakhs per annum, supported by a valid income certificate issued by State Authorities only [Scholarship_AY_2026_27_website_Apr_1_6c85696a82.pdf, p. 2-3]. Scholarships are awarded after the completion of the admission cycle [Scholarship_AY_2026_27_website_Apr_1_6c85696a82.pdf, p. 2-3].
- **Financial Conditions:** Covers tuition fee waiver as part of the TFW scheme (specific waiver fraction/amount not further detailed, though categorized under tuition fee waivers) [Scholarship_AY_2026_27_website_Apr_1_6c85696a82.pdf, p. 2-3].

**William Webster Merit-cum-Means Scholarship:**
- **Award Conditions:** 02 scholarships are awarded in the BTech program (one each in Sec-62 and Sec-128) [Scholarship_AY_2026_27_website_Apr_1_6c85696a82.pdf, p. 2-3]. Eligibility requires the combined income of parents to be less than Rs. 8.0 Lac per annum [Scholarship_AY_2026_27_website_Apr_1_6c85696a82.pdf, p. 2-3]. A merit list is prepared in the second semester considering the student's marks in class 10th, class 12th, and the result of the first semester [Scholarship_AY_2026_27_website_Apr_1_6c85696a82.pdf, p. 2-3]. It is awarded in the Even Semester every year [Scholarship_AY_2026_27_website_Apr_1_6c85696a82.pdf, p. 2-3]. Scholarship continuity is subject to maintaining a CGPA of 7.00 in subsequent semesters and the submission of a valid income certificate issued by State Authorities [Scholarship_AY_2026_27_website_Apr_1_6c85696a82.pdf, p. 2-3]. (Note: An initial corpus of Rs. 20 lacs was set up by Jaiprakash Sewa Sansthan for this scholarship, operational since 2004-05, granting a tuition fee waiver of one semester in an academic year to meritorious students with economically weak conditions admitted to JIIT) [JIIT_Annual_Report_2023_24_1b8f143aca.pdf, p. 200-201].
- **Financial Conditions:** Provides a tuition fee waiver in the academic year equivalent to the tuition fee of one semester [Scholarship_AY_2026_27_website_Apr_1_6c85696a82.pdf, p. 2-3].
